name: via puncti
answers: the hidden root / true motive behind the question
source: Cameron Finan thesis p.146 (Libro de los juysios, f.12v-13); J.M. Greer, Caduceus 2.2; D. Conant Digital Ambler; Olomi (Arabic version)
procedure:

figure as a whole. At each level, keep only the parent(s) whose same row matches the
child's row.
  Judge(XV) -> Witnesses(XIII, XIV) -> Nieces(IX..XII) -> Mothers(I..IV) or Daughters(V..VIII)
If neither parent matches, the path dies there. If both match, the path branches
("two-headed"/"four-headed" in the French sources). If the Judge's head row cannot be

a path ending in the 1st/2nd/4th houses gives motive as self / money / property.

name: parentage
answers: why a derived figure is stronger or weaker than its name suggests
source: Calatarama f.22v; Table 4 note that 12 figures change by location
procedure:
{"answers": "why a derived figure is stronger or weaker than its name suggests", "conf": "HIGH", "procedure": "A generated figure inherits the quality of the two that engendered it:
  bad + bad -> "evil from two parts";  good + good -> "good from two parts";
  mixed -> judge by the better/worse parent according to the question.
So never read N/W/Judge/Sentence as bare figures: always read them with their parents named.
Worked example from f.37 (6th house, "will the sick man recover"): Amissio there KILLS when
it is born of Fortuna Minor+Conjunctio, or Cauda+Rubeus, or Puer+Tristitia.
Worked example from f.42 (7th house, marriage): Conjunctio born of Populus+Conjunctio
"demonstrates the perfection of the union".
", "source": "Calatarama f.22v; Table 4 note that 12 figures change by location"}

name: evil eye and crossed conditions
answers: is the check being blocked by envy, and by whom
source: kitchentoad.com 'Geomancy to Diagnose the Evil Eye (and Crossed Conditions)'
procedure:
{"answers": "is the check being blocked by envy, and by whom", "conf": "MED", "procedure": "Judge MOBILE -> the eye has not been contracted (except Via/Conjunctio = sent by accident);
Judge STABLE -> it has. Right witness = its origin, left witness = its immediate effect.
If Via Puncti forms, the house it ends in is where the eye was first encountered.
House I + II together -> the envy is aimed at something the querent HOLDS (child, wealth).
House VI figure names the body part it has seated in (Puer=head, Albus=lungs, Rubeus=genitals,
...). House VIII = intended effect and severity: a malefic there while the Judge says 'no eye'
still means a curse is running; a benefics there while the Judge says 'yes eye' means the
sender did not intend harm / is not a practitioner. House XII = what is hidden, and its
INVERSE is the means of clearing it.
", "source": "kitchentoad.com 'Geomancy to Diagnose the Evil Eye (and Crossed Conditions)'"}
